India Successfully Tests Drone Killer and Anti-Tank Missile Systems

India has successfully test-fired the JWALA MK-1, a homegrown autonomous CUAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System) micro-missile system, at the Pokhran range. Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) is reportedly also testing similar kinetic interceptors for drones. Separately, Adani Defence successfully demonstrated a vehicle-mounted anti-tank guided missile system, firing four missiles at the Pokhran Test Range.
